summary: Tested new additive modules: Stüdyo Paneli (Studio Suite) and Davetiye Tasarım Stüdyosu. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed (studio plans/register/login/me + KVKK/duplicate/wrong-password guards, design fonts/templates/CRUD/upload/asset + auth guards, regression on services/admin-login/print-options). Frontend: /studyo portal renders glassmorphism, register flow generates valid FTB-XXXXX code, redirects to /studyo/panel showing Deneme status/Filigran Zorunlu/limits (AI 0, 10 GB, 2 events) and 5 plan cards; logout and login with studio1@test.com/Test1234 both work. /tasarim-studyosu editor loads, all toolbar buttons work (metin/başlık/rect/circle/line), property panel appears, Şablonlar dialog shows 5 templates and loads wedding-classic objects, sample name input works, Kaydet without main-site login correctly shows 'Kaydetmek için üye girişi gerekli' toast and redirects to /giris. Home '/' still loads without pageerrors. No blocking bugs found.

issues: Console warning: color <input type=color> receives 'rgb(0,0,0)' / '#111' — must be '#rrggbb'. Non-blocking but should normalize the color state to hex before setting the input value.
Console error: <circle> attribute cx/cy 'undefined' — a lucide/SVG icon prop is undefined somewhere in the editor toolbar/panel. Cosmetic but noisy.
DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description on Şablonlar dialog (a11y warning).

action_items: Optional: normalize color state to '#rrggbb' before setting into <input type=color> in DesignStudio.jsx to remove console warnings.
Optional: guard SVG icons receiving undefined cx/cy props (minor console error).
Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Şablonlar dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: studio.py _studio_state returns days_left computed from (ref-now).days plus +1 if seconds>0 → on registration this correctly yields 3, verified by test.
design_studio.py upload endpoint validates content_type prefix 'image/' (good) and size <=15MB.
Design projects reuse main-site get_current_user (db.users) as documented — regression untouched.
Studio JWT: get_current_studio accepts either studio_token/access_token cookie OR Authorization Bearer with role='studio' — behaves correctly (401 on missing, 200 on Bearer).
test_credentials: admin@fotuber.com.tr/FTB.2024 (main-site); studio1@test.com/Test1234 (existing studio); new TEST_studio_*/StudioPass123 accounts created per test run.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_studio_<ts>@example.com studio accounts and one TEST Design project (deleted at end of CRUD test). Design assets uploaded during test are left in DB (small 1x1 PNG).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both additive modules are working end-to-end. Studio auth uses separate collection studio_accounts + role='studio' JWT; design projects reuse main-site user auth. FTB regex allows 5 or 6 uppercase alphanumeric chars (fallback branch). Only cosmetic console warnings remain in DesignStudio (color input format + one undefined cx/cy SVG prop).
